items.title: Two bodies recovered from Himlung avalanche site
items.blurb: Identities of the victims remain unknown as rescuers search the area after an avalanche left 14 people unaccounted for.

items.title: Floods and landslides kill 12 across Nepal
items.blurb: Seven people remain missing and more than 1,100 have been evacuated as heavy rain raises the risk of further disasters.

items.title: 14 Nepalis missing on Himlung after avalanche as bad weather hampers rescue
items.blurb: Helicopters are on standby in Kathmandu and Pokhara, but poor weather has so far prevented rescuers from reaching the mountain.

items.title: Bangkok floodwaters recede after torrential rain as residents count losses
items.blurb: Torrential rain flooded roads and homes across Bangkok, forcing thousands into temporary shelters as authorities warned that some areas remained under water despite improving weather.

items.title: Flood washes away around 80 houses in Parbat as landslide kills one in Palpa
items.blurb: The Kaligandaki river flooded the Farse settlement, while a landslide buried a house and a cattle shed in Palpa, leaving one dead and two missing.

items.title: 10 missing after avalanche hits Himlung Himal
items.blurb: Climbers and support staff are unaccounted for after an avalanche struck the 7,126-metre peak in Manang’s Nar Phu area.

items.title: Relentless rain triggers floods, landslides across Nepal
items.blurb: Floodwaters sweep away six houses in Butwal, major rivers cross danger marks in Chitwan and landslides disrupt highways and roads in several districts.

items.title: Why Nepal’s latest disaster needs a local name—not just a scientific label
items.blurb: We use words like ‘tsunami’ and ‘monsoon’ to honour the communities who know these disasters best. It’s time for Nepal to do the same.

items.title: Khanal meets UAE counterpart, thanks Abu Dhabi for $25m flood aid
items.blurb: Foreign minister Shisir Khanal also holds talks with his Armenian counterpart on expanding bilateral cooperation

items.title: Flood sweeps away bridge linking Syangja and Gulmi
items.blurb: The bridge over the Kaligandaki river was washed away after four days of continuous rain caused the river to swell.

items.title: Nepal’s tourism industry keeps absorbing one crisis after another — and keeps coming back
items.blurb: Despite the pandemic, political unrest and natural disasters, Nepal’s tourism industry has endured, with visitors returning after each shock. But is that resilience masking the need to build a safer, more diversified…

items.title: Incessant rains trigger widespread flooding in Tarai, disrupt key highway links across Nepal
items.blurb: Swollen Narayani and Saptakoshi rivers submerge hundreds of homes in Nawalparasi West and Saptari, forcing rescues. Landslides and road erosion cut off vital routes, including Prithvi and BP highways.

items.title: Finance Minister Wagle leaves for Doha
items.blurb: Wagle is expected to seek support for post-flood reconstruction and climate finance while advancing infrastructure projects with the multilateral lender.

items.title: Vegetable prices skyrocket in Valley as landslides disrupt transport
items.blurb: Arrivals have fallen by nearly two-thirds since Thursday as highways to major vegetable-producing districts are damaged in places, leading to a steep price rises.

items.title: As rain returns, flood survivors endure cold—and leaking tents
items.blurb: Damp weather has raised health concerns for infants and vulnerable groups as permanent resettlement plan awaits central government approval.

items.title: Dhap Dam remains fully safe, says energy ministry
items.blurb: The dam’s water level has fallen by 2.38 metres after authorities began releasing water following a landslide near a saddle dam.

items.title: Shah returns from UNGA after putting climate crisis at centre of Nepal’s global pitch
items.blurb: Nepal’s prime minister highlighted the Bhotekoshi floods, climate justice and Himalayan risks at the UN General Assembly, while seeking greater international support for resilience and reconstruction.

items.title: Koshi floods inundate 157 homes in Saptari
items.blurb: Floodwaters entered homes in Tilathi Koiladi and Hanumannagar Kankalini, damaging food stocks and forcing residents to seek shelter on higher ground.

items.title: A month on, Nepal flood victims remain missing as hope and posters fade
items.blurb: Relatives plastered hospital walls in Kathmandu with notices searching for loved ones swept away by the Bhotekoshi floods. With thousands still unaccounted for, many families have turned to symbolic last rites.

items.title: Thai capital Bangkok declared disaster zone amid flooding
items.blurb: Torrential rain floods Bangkok roads, homes and public spaces, prompting authorities to open shelters, deploy the army and urge residents near canals to move to higher ground.
